sm_top.sm: The United States considered ending annual military aid to Israel.
The death toll from a Russian strike on an aid center in Komyshuvakha has risen to 43.
Multiple oil tankers and a tug caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz and off the coast of Oman after being struck by projectiles or mines.
Ukraine reports a deadly Russian double-tap bombing on a village, resulting in at least 40 deaths.
Ukrainian drones struck the Ryazan oil refinery and a logistics hub, causing fires and one injury.
Kyiv authorities report water supply disruptions following Russian strikes on energy infrastructure in the Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions.
The death toll in the Houthi missile attack on Riyadh Airport rose to 14 after a second Indian national died from injuries.
The death toll from a Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha has risen to 43.
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 105 of 128 Russian drones and missiles in an overnight attack.
A Houthi missile attack on a military camp in Yemen resulted in 13 deaths.
Police report 42 bodies recovered from rubble following a Russian strike on the village of Komyshuvakha.
Russian MoD claims strikes on Kharkiv infrastructure, including a thermal power plant and a drone assembly warehouse.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen killed at least 12 civilians, including six children, with a total death toll reaching 24.
Russian strikes have forced Ukrainian nuclear power plants to reduce their electricity generating capacity.
President Zelensky condemned a Russian attack on a school that resulted in at least 40 deaths.
Ukrainian air defenses destroyed over 8,000 aerial targets during October 2026.
North Korea conducted tests of its air defenses and airfield strike capabilities.
Italy is finalizing a new military aid package for Ukraine, which may include Aster anti-aircraft missiles.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile and a drone targeting the Madinah region and the Eastern Province.
Russia and Iran sign missile launcher deal
An Israeli drone strike in southern Lebanon killed one person.
The Indian Navy rescued 20 crew members from an Iranian fishing boat hijacked off the coast of Somalia.
A series of bomb threats against passenger flights across Europe led to emergency landings and airport closures.
South Korea announced plans to deploy a military mission to the Strait of Hormuz to help keep the waterway open.
A Finnish court sentenced crew members to prison for their role in the sabotage of a Baltic Sea undersea cable.
Russian drone attack debris caused a fire in the Bucha district.
Polish authorities detained six individuals suspected of organizing shipments for Russian weapons production.
A Ukrainian drone strike set a warehouse ablaze in Russia.
An Israeli drone strike killed one Palestinian and wounded another at a displacement tent in Gaza.
A Jordanian security officer was killed in a stabbing attack in Amman.
Norway deployed NASAMS air defense sensors and additional troops to the Sør-Varanger garrison near the Russian border to monitor for drones.
Israeli airstrikes in Gaza killed several militants, including a Hamas commander involved in holding an Israeli hostage.
Ukrainian drone attacks in Russia's Belgorod region killed three people.
Israeli airstrikes in Gaza killed five people, including a child, according to Palestinian sources.
Renewed fighting in Ethiopia's Tigray region has forced families to flee.
Houthi forces shot down a Saudi Wing Loong II armed reconnaissance drone over Taiz.
Yemeni government forces reported territorial gains in Taiz following clashes and a Houthi missile strike that killed four civilians.
The International Court of Justice announced it will deliver its judgment on November 19 in the genocide case against Myanmar.
Yemeni forces reported the destruction of three Houthi missile launch systems.
Iran claims to have shot down a US drone over Qeshm Island.
